title: RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.36843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interpretability methods such as probes, activation patches and learned editors are designed to reveal or modify a model's current computation. World models pose a harder requirement: because their predictions become inputs to later predictions, a useful internal correction must survive after editing stops. We therefore propose RolloutFaith, a framework that measures semantic improvement both in the prediction produced at intervention time and over later autonomous predictions under fixed events, actions, noise, and information budgets. We evaluate ten fitted editors on three world models across Crafter, Cartpole, and CoinRun. We also use Reference Activation Patching, which replaces a model activation with the paired activation computed from the real observation, to measure the correction available at the chosen interface. translated_title: RolloutFaith：审计视觉世界模型中的持久性内部干预
translated_abstract: 诸如探针、激活补丁和习得编辑器等可解释性方法旨在揭示或修改模型当前的运算过程。而世界模型提出了更严格的要求：由于其预测会成为后续预测的输入，因此有用的内部修正必须在编辑停止后仍然持续有效。为此，我们提出了 RolloutFaith，一个在固定事件、动作、噪声和信息预算条件下，同时衡量干预时刻产生的预测以及后续自主预测的语义改进的框架。我们在三个世界模型上，针对 Crafter、Cartpole 和 CoinRun 三个任务环境评估了十种拟合编辑器。我们还使用了参考激活补丁（Reference Activation Patching），即用从真实观测计算得到的配对激活替换模型激活，以测量所选接口处可用的修正量。这种参考干预在全部九种模型与任务组合中都改善了后续预测，并优于……
tldr: 提出 RolloutFaith 框架，用于审计世界模型中的内部干预能否在编辑停止后持续改善后续自主预测，并引入参考激活补丁作为衡量接口修正能力的参考标准。
en_tdlr: We propose RolloutFaith, a framework that audits whether internal interventions in visual world models persistently improve subsequent autonomous predictions, and introduces Reference Activation Patching as a reference standard for measuring available corrections.
